description:
** THIS IS A PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE. NO QUOTES WILL BE ACCEPTED UNTIL THE REQUEST FOR QUOTE (RFQ) IS POSTED. **

Description of Requirement: The 76th CMXG is requesting utilization of funds for the purchase of Colfax C1G83250RDW Pump component for the Low-Pressure Pump Modules (LPPM).

The requested equipment specifications are outlined below.
Colfax C1G83250RDW (Qty: 2) Pump component for the Low-Pressure Pump Modules (LPPM) or Equivalent.

a)    Two Stage Pump with external drain
b)    Frame: 8
c)    Suction: 3-inch 4 bolt pad
d)    Discharge: 2-inch 4 bolt pad
e)    Shaft Plane: Horizontal
f)    Rotation: Clockwise when looking at Pump Shaft
g)    Max Discharge Flow Rate: 115 GPM
h)    Discharge Pressure: 4600 PSI
i)    Operating Speed: 1750 rpm

Contemplated contract details:

  • Firm-fixed price (FFP)
  • 100% Small Business Set-Aside
  • FSC/PSC – 5120
  • NAICS – 332510
  • Size Standard – 750 Employees

Requirements for Award:

System for Award Management (SAM) is required to receive any award. Vendors can register electronically at https://sam.gov/content/home.
